snippet.title: DEADLINE DELIVERY - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3745310/DEADLINE_DELIVERY/

Step into the driver’s seat of this fast, chaotic, and skill-driven racing experience, where you play as Carl — a monkey mailman who’s been late on his deliveries. Fed up with your missed deadlines, your boss has rigged your truck with explosives… and the timer’s already ticking.

✉️ DELIVER MAIL
Your job is simple... deliver the mail before time runs out.

🌐 MULTIPLAYER
Play solo or with up to 8 players — invite friends or match with other players.

🏁 TRICKS
Pull off flips, dodge obstacles, and beat the clock — or explode trying.
